canvas.$description: Survey field book — light cool map paper (direction role: canvas). Target AAA chrome on this ground.

field-ink.$description: Survey field book — graphite near-black (direction role: ink). Named field-ink so HUD --color-ink stays light while legacy HUD aliases remain.

field-ink-muted.$description: Survey field book — secondary copy (direction role: ink-muted). Keep ≥4.5:1 on panels; play chrome prefers field-ink.

flag.$description: Survey field book — fluoro survey orange (direction role: flag). Primary CTA / active tool / stake chips only (~≤15%).

flag-ink.$description: Ink on flag fills for AAA play chrome.

flag-soft.$description: Soft flag wash for chips / selected chrome.

signal.$description: Survey field book — cool blue (direction role: signal). Info / sync OK — always pair with label/icon.

trail.$description: Survey field book — green (direction role: trail). Success / in-zone — always pair with label/icon.

halt.$description: Survey field book — red (direction role: halt). Error / dead session — always pair with label/icon.

rule.$description: Survey field book — hairline graphite (direction role: rule) for status/island edges.
